design: Ambiguous, incomplete and edge-case analyst questions (missing period or company, vague metric, open-ended updates, fiscal vs calendar wording, brands/tickers/former names, ambiguous names, out-of-scope requests, unreported periods with estimate pressure, private and non-SEC companies, malformed input, mixed answerable/unanswerable parts). Written by an analyst subagent from a behaviour spec (answer with stated assumptions / clarify / decline the out-of-scope part / say it cannot exist), split from a 40-question pool at random within each category (seed 20261004); the other half is evals/edge_dev.jsonl.
verification: Reporting periods, statuses and dates checked against SEC submissions and the agent-independent calendar code; FedEx fiscal-year change, Walgreens delisting (25-NSE 2025-08-28) and Publix 10-Q filing confirmed from EDGAR.
rule: Frozen before any agent run on it; no agent code changes in response to its results.
